subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should OpenClaw commit to this public portable `table` presentation block and its cross-channel fallback semantics now?
rationale: The change expands the supported plugin SDK contract and establishes broad delivery semantics that will affect third-party callers; mechanical correctness fixes do not decide whether maintainers want to own that permanent API.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Keep the portable table API, fix Slack fallback chunking, resolve the base conflict, and require live Slack proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Slack-local support
options.body: Keep native table support inside the Slack plugin until portable cross-channel table semantics receive separate approval.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the PR if maintainers are not ready to own the new public presentation contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the portable table API, fix Slack fallback chunking, resolve the base conflict, and require live Slack proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and the strongest current-main history match for the adjacent portable presentation API.
